title: Gear, version 2
description: A file under content/gear/ (work order 029; combat.json revision 10, content/tuning/tools.json). gear/1 plus every slot of the seven-slot loadout and the tool slots. A top-level id of the form gear.<zone>.<name>. 'gear' lists one entry per gear item: item, the id of an item under content/items/; slot, one of weapon, off_hand, head, body, hands, feet, charm (combat.json gear.loadout), tool (one tool slot per gathering and production skill, tools.json slots), or armour, the legacy revision-9 slot that content/gear/cinderworks.json still uses until it moves (combat.json gear.legacy_armour_slot); style, melee, marksmanship or aetherics, weapons only; skill, the skill whose tool slot a tool fills, tools only; level_required, the level that gates wearing it: the weapon's style level, combat level (the highest of Melee, Marksmanship and Aetherics) for off_hand, head, body, hands, feet and charm, the tool's own skill level for a tool, and Fortitude for the legacy armour slot (combat.json gear.combat_level, gear.legacy_armour_slot; tools.json wear); stats_by_calibration, exactly 21 rows, +0 to +20. A weapon row is {calibration, power, accuracy}, power in the model's x10 units; an armour, off_hand, head, body, hands or feet row is {calibration, armour}; a charm row is {calibration, accuracy}; a tool row is {calibration, speed_percent}. Rows +1 to +20 may be null while the calibration step is open. Rules this subset of JSON Schema cannot say (row n has calibration n, row +0 is not null, which stats each slot's rows carry, style only and always on weapons, skill only and always on tools, one entry per item across gear/1 and gear/2) are checked by scripts/validate/gear.py for the combat check; a tool's +0 speed_percent against tools.json's rule is checked by scripts/validate/check_pacing.py.
